snippet.title: Miniatures - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Miniatures is a collection of strange tales where childhood imagination and reality merge with darker undercurrents of mystery and magic. Explore a vast seascape, build odd furniture, feed a lizard and play with sand castles. 

Buy the game here: 
Steam: https://bit.ly/miniaturesSteam
Nintendo Switch: https://bit.ly/miniaturesNOE | https://bit.ly/miniaturesNOA
AppStore: https://bit.ly/miniaturesAppStore
Itch: https://bit.ly/miniaturesItch
